summary:
`list.ts` now supports the filters, but `todo list --done` and `--todo` will not work from the command line yet. The fix needs a change to `src/cli.ts`, which is outside this node's writable scope, so I didn't make it.

**What changed (`src/commands/list.ts`, `src/commands/list.test.ts`):**
- `runList(dir, filter = 'all')` takes an optional filter of `'all' | 'done' | 'todo'`. Calling `runList(dir)` still gives exactly the old output, so `cli.ts` and existing callers are unaffected.
- `'done'` returns only completed rows. `'todo'` returns only incomplete rows.
- A filtered view has no `共 N 项…`
